description: Concordant fold across the demand/transport fixpoint (north star: reduce concepts/code). CallInputMode { Direct, Closure } is defined TWICE (jobs/runtime_demand.rs:2496-2499 and jobs/transport.rs:46-49) and the identical HashMap<CallSiteId,CallInputMode> is computed from the SAME LoweredBody by two independently-written functions: runtime_demand.rs:895-935 (call_modes_by_callsite/record_tail_call_mode, flat iteration) and transport.rs:2150-2159+2286 (collect_callsite_modes/collect_tail_call_modes, recursive ControlDestination walk). The recursive walk is duplicated a THIRD time in transport.rs as collect_tail_call_dests/collect_tail_call_args (same recursion shape, different payload) -> fold into one generic tail-walk. Also semantic_index is defined twice with the same 3-arg signature (callee_input_len, arg_count, arg_index): runtime_demand.rs:2500-2506 returns usize (assumes valid -> latent panic/UB risk), transport.rs:50-58 returns Option<usize> (checked). FIX: one CallInputMode in a shared module (body.rs, beside LoweredTail::DirectCall/ClosureCall it classifies); one map-builder; absorb the CHECKED semantic_index (strictly safer). Concordance check: both consumers read the SAME LoweredTail Direct/Closure distinction to answer 'how do this callsite's args map onto the callee positional input space given the closure-capture prefix'; the only difference (checked vs unchecked) is an oversight, not a deliberate invariant. ~20 non-test refs, contained to two jobs/ files. MODERATE: touches fixpoint demand/transport facts -> full green lib+matrix re-verify. Two/three-lane audit.
